description: Three oscillators tuned from one pitch: a fundamental and two detuned voices that can be spread apart, quantized to a scale or beaten against each other

params.text: Sets the base frequency of all three oscillators; the two frequency knobs work as a coarse and a fine tune on the same pitch
Sets the base frequency of all three oscillators; the two frequency knobs work as a coarse and a fine tune on the same pitch
Spreads oscillators 2 and 3 away from the base frequency, by an even amount, a scaled amount, a chord or a division of the unity input according to the beat mode button
Sets the level of oscillator 2 in the detuned output, -5V to +5V; patching the oscillator 2 level input takes this knob out of circuit
Multiplies the oscillator 3 level input by -1 to +1; with nothing patched to that input it reads 5V, so the knob alone sets oscillator 3's level from -5V to +5V
Attenuates the phase input that modulates oscillators 2 and 3, from nothing at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Attenuates the detune input, from nothing at fully counter-clockwise to all of it at fully clockwise
Shifts the whole module up an octave each time it is clicked, as far as +5 Octaves
Steps through the waveform all three oscillators use: Saw, Square, Trapezoid or Triangle
Turns sampling of the oscillator 2 and 3 levels on or off, so they either track their cables or are held at each cycle of oscillator 1
Shifts the whole module down an octave each time it is clicked, as far as +0 Octaves
Steps through the scale the detune is quantized to: Off, Semitone, Major or Minor
Steps through how the detune is spread: Even, Scaled, Chords, or Sync to Unity Input
Nothing in the Rack module reads this button; the unity input jack beside it is what drives that function

inputs.text: Sets the level of oscillator 2 in the detuned output; patched here, it overrides the oscillator 2 level knob
Sets the level of oscillator 3 in the detuned output, multiplied by the oscillator 3 level knob; unpatched it reads 5V
Volt-per-octave pitch for all three oscillators, read at 384 units of the internal 12-bit control range per volt
Modulates the phase of oscillators 2 and 3, through the 2 + 3 phase CV scale knob
Modulates the detune spread, through the detune CV scale knob
A rising edge here shifts the module up an octave
The signal oscillators 2 and 3 are locked against when the beat mode button is set to Sync to Unity Input

outputs.text: Oscillators 2 and 3 mixed at their own levels
A 5V gate that follows the beat between the detuned oscillators
Oscillator 1 on its own, the undetuned fundamental
A 5V trigger each time the pitch changes

notes: the A input is normalled to the A knob: with nothing patched the knob sets that voltage, and patching a cable into A takes the knob out of circuit entirely.
the oscillator 3 level input is normalled to 5V and the 3 LVL knob multiplies whatever arrives by -1 to +1. Unpatched it is a -5V to +5V source; patched it attenuverts the cable.
the detuned output is oscillators 2 and 3 at the levels set by the 2 LVL and 3 LVL controls. Set both to 0V and that output goes silent, while oscillator 1 keeps coming out of its own jack.
each of the six buttons steps to the next mode when clicked. Hovering one names the mode and its number; right-click and you can type either to jump straight to it.
menu: Optimized — runs the oscillators through the plugin's faster path, which is the setting to leave it on; found under the CPU Mode heading
Direct Port — runs the hardware firmware straight through, which costs more CPU; found under the CPU Mode heading
Select Scale Set File — loads a scale file from disk in place of the one the module ships with
